items.name: The checklist holds one stamped item per stamped scenario of the source cut
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written
items.evidence: K-3 pinned, 03-001/03-002/04-001 stamped; derive-checklist -> checklist-derived with the 3 items in offered order, total 3, sha256 digest; query returns same. Same items at K-4 give the same digest; different set (K-5) or order (K-6) give different digests. Variations refused correctly: unpinned cut (cut-not-pinned), re-derive (checklist-already-derived), item twice (item-twice).

items.name: The checklist reads the spec as the stamper does: file order, Rule, source line and trimmed title
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written
items.evidence: Offered 03-002 (rule null, :3) then 03-001 (rule 'Stamping', source s/03/spec.feature:6, title 'a padded title'); event and query keep that order and fields, not sorted by id.

items.name: A planned or backlog slice left out of the checklist is on record
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written
items.evidence: Items of slice 05 only with skipped-slices [03 planned, 04 backlog]; checklist-derived and the checklist query hold only 05 items and record both skipped slices with their statuses.

items.name: Every unstamped scenario of every file refuses the checklist and is listed
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written
items.evidence: Two unstamped scenarios offered -> -32000 unstamped-scenarios, data.unstamped lists both (source, title), message names specification/stamp-slice; checklist query null.

items.name: A checklist that would hold no stamped item is refused
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written
items.evidence: Empty items, all slices skipped -> -32000 empty-checklist; checklist query null.

items.name: A stamped item whose item identity the stamper never handed out is refused
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written
items.evidence: Only 03-001 stamped; offering 03-001 and 03-007 -> -32000 item-never-stamped, item-ids [03-007]; checklist null.

items.name: A stamped item with an empty title is refused
items.rule: The checklist is derived from the stamped scenarios at a pinned source cut, never written
items.evidence: 03-001 offered with title '' -> -32000 empty-title, item-ids [03-001]; checklist null (also with a valid item beside it). A whitespace-only title is accepted, as allium requires 7 says.

items.name: Item verdicts for a cycle whose source cut has no checklist are refused
items.rule: The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only
items.evidence: C-7 gated (D-1, K-3), K-3 pinned but no checklist; file-item-verdicts -> -32000 no-checklist; cycle-measurement null; file-score -> zero-verdicts.

items.name: Zero item verdicts file nothing, never every item failed
items.rule: The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only
items.evidence: Empty verdicts -> -32000 zero-verdicts; cycle-measurement null; file-score -> zero-verdicts (no score shown).

items.name: A verdict that is neither pass nor fail is refused before an unknown item
items.rule: The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only
items.evidence: 'maybe' for 03-001 + pass for unknown 09-001 -> bad-verdict-value (either order); measurement null; file-score -> zero-verdicts.

items.name: A verdict for an item not on the checklist is refused
items.rule: The approved sealed grader files the item verdicts it returned for the gated candidate only
items.evidence: pass 03-001, pass 09-001 -> -32000 unknown-item, item-ids [09-001]; measurement null; file-score zero-verdicts.

items.name: The measurement holds every checklist item once, in checklist order
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted
items.evidence: Verdicts filed fail 04-001, pass 03-001, pass 03-002; file-score -> measurement-filed items in checklist order 03-001,03-002,04-001; total 3 passes 2 unreached 0; checklist-digest equals K-3's; grader-digests [G-1]; query status filed.

items.name: An item with no verdict is filed as fail with the reason unreached and counted
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted
items.evidence: Only pass 03-001 filed; measurement files 03-002 and 03-003 as fail reason unreached; total 3, unreached 2, passes 1.

items.name: An outage reads differently from a regression, and the verdict stays pass or fail
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted
items.evidence: fail+outage 03-001, fail no reason 03-002 -> measurement 03-001 fail reason outage, 03-002 fail with no reason key; inconclusive also carried.

items.name: Duplicate verdicts: the last filed stands and the earlier ones are listed as superseded
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted
items.evidence: fail then pass for 03-001 (one call, and across two filings G-1/G-2) -> item pass; superseded [{03-001, G-1, fail}].

items.name: A verdict filed without evidence carries empty evidence
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted
items.evidence: Verdict without evidence -> evidence '' in item-verdicts-filed and in the measurement items; given evidence kept.

items.name: A score with zero item verdicts filed is refused
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted
items.evidence: Gated C-7, no verdicts; file-score -> -32000 zero-verdicts; cycle-measurement null (awaiting). Ungated C-8 -> not-the-gated-candidate.

items.name: A baseline cycle's scoreboard rates every item and has no previous cycle
items.rule: The scoreboard is reported once a cycle, to a person, never into the loop
items.evidence: Filed 2 of 3 for C-7 (no earlier cycle); policy reported scoreboard before file-score returned: passes 2, total 3, rate '66.7%', previous-cycle-id null; measurements-to-report empty; manual report-scoreboard -> scoreboard-already-reported.

items.name: A scoreboard for a cycle with no measurement filed is refused
items.rule: The scoreboard is reported once a cycle, to a person, never into the loop
items.evidence: C-8 score stage failed; report-scoreboard C-8 -> -32000 no-measurement-filed; scoreboard null.

items.name: A cycle after an unscored one is compared with the last measured cycle, not the one before it
items.rule: A cycle is compared with the last measured cycle of the same selection, both directions apart, never a net
items.evidence: C-5 measured, C-6 gated with no measurement (and variant: C-6 score stage failed, plus a measured cycle of another selection in between); C-7 scoreboard previous-cycle-id C-5, never C-6/C-6b/C-7.

items.name: Newly passing and newly failing shared items are counted apart, with no net
items.rule: A cycle is compared with the last measured cycle of the same selection, both directions apart, never a net
items.evidence: C-6: 03-001 pass, 03-002 fail; C-7: reverse -> shared newly-passing [03-002], newly-failing [03-001], previous-rate 50.0%, rate 50.0%; no net field.

items.name: The comparison is restated on the shared items only when the item set moved
items.rule: A cycle is compared with the last measured cycle of the same selection, both directions apart, never a net
items.evidence: C-6 total 3, C-7 total 4 (03-004 added) -> restatement previous-total 3, total 4, added 1, dropped 0; C-8 with unchanged item set -> restatement null.

items.name: A rate exactly on a half rounds to the even digit
items.rule: A rate has one decimal, rounded half to even, and "n/a" over zero

items.name: A previous cycle with no shared item rates the shared items "n/a"
items.rule: A rate has one decimal, rounded half to even, and "n/a" over zero
items.evidence: C-6 only 03-001, C-7 only 04-001 -> shared items 0, previous-rate and rate 'n/a'; new-items [04-001], dropped [03-001].

items.name: The approved grader files its item verdicts for the candidate the gate ratified

items.name: Item verdicts from a grader digest that is not approved are refused

items.name: A score whose grader digest is no longer approved when it is filed is refused
items.rule: The score files one measurement of every checklist item; an unreached item fails and stays counted
items.evidence: G-1 filed while approved; file-score with approved [G-2] -> grader-not-approved; measurement null, measurements-to-report empty (still awaiting); a later file-score with [G-1] files it.

items.evidence: Verdicts refused unknown-item; fail-score-stage(unknown-item) -> score-stage-failed event; cycle-measurement status score-stage-failed, refusal unknown-item, no total/passes; second fail-score-stage refused score-stage-failed; scoreboard null.
